Deliver clean project files, utilize reusable assets, and maintain a highly organized library to support a high-volume output of thousands of videos.   Directly design, construct, and manage a core library of 5–6 high-quality 3D characters tailored for yogic animations.   Maintain efficient production timelines with a target output of 1 high-quality video every 1–2 days, demonstrating technical efficiency during an initial practical assignment. Hands-on experience with 3D character pipelines (rigging, retargeting, and rendering) and a strong understanding of human anatomy.
